summary: Longstanding civil property dispute; criminal proceedings initiated by respondent despite appellants filing civil suits; FIR allegations absurd and inherently improbable; history of false cases by respondent and family; acquittal in prior similar case; quashing justified under Section 482 Cr.P.C.; proceedings deemed mala fide and abusive; Bhajan Lal principles applied; interference by High Court inappropriate.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order XXXIX Rules 1 and 2
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; criminal proceedings quashed; impugned judgment set aside.
